description: Shared test vector for splitting one file's unified patch into hunks (docs/ux-v3.md section 2). Hunks are numbered from 1 in patch order, walking the patch by the @@ line counts (as in packages/explain/src/difflines.ts), so content lines that look like headers are not hunk boundaries. Used by the web walkthrough UI (DIG-50) and meant for the walkthrough validator (DIG-48).

cases.name: git headers, a content line that looks like a file header, omitted counts, no-newline marker
cases.patch:
diff --git a/src/api.ts b/src/api.ts
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/api.ts
+++ b/src/api.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@ import
 a
--- not a header
+++ not a header either
 b
@@ -10 +10 @@
-old
+new
\ No newline at end of file
@@ -20,2 +20,3 @@ fn
 x
+y
 z

cases.name: a line that looks like a hunk header inside a hunk body is content
empty or header-only patch has no hunks
cases.patch: Binary files a/logo.png and b/logo.png differ
